result.note: Tests who brought the WTO challenge to the EU carbon border tax and why India joined as a third party.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India reserved third-party rights in a World Trade Organization dispute over the European Union's carbon border tax. Consider the following statements:
items: India is the complainant that brought the dispute against the European Union.
The dispute directly affects Indian steel and aluminium exporters.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the challenge was brought by Russia, and India only reserved third-party rights. Reserving these rights lets India follow a case that directly affects its own steel and aluminium exporters.
questions.source: India reserved third-party rights in Russia's WTO challenge to the EU's carbon border tax, letting it follow a case that directly affects its own steel and aluminium exporters.
